allOf.description: Payload for creating a run. **Important**: If the agent uses an input form trigger, the `input` field is required and must include all fields defined in the form schema. Even fields marked as optional in the UI must be included in the request—use an empty string (`""`) for optional fields without values. Omitting required form fields will result in a 500 error.

agent_id.title: Agent Id
agent_id.description: The ID of the agent to run.

input.title: Input
input.description: The input to the agent. Required when the agent uses an input form trigger.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The messages to pass an input to the agent.

metadata.title: Metadata

status.title: AgentExecutionStatus

messages.title: Messages

422.description: Returned when the agent has tools the caller has not authorized. The response body enumerates the tools that need connecting.

schema.title: UnauthorizedAgentToolsError
schema.description: Returned when the agent has tools the caller must authorize before the run can start. Each entry in `authenticationSuggestions` names one such tool; POST its `serverId` to `/tool-servers/{serverId}/auth` with `returnUrl` in the request body to obtain an `authorizationUrl` to redirect the end user to, then retry the run once OAuth completes.

authenticationSuggestions.description: One entry per tool the caller must authorize.

requestType.description: The type of request made to the user.

x-enumDescriptions.EXECUTION: Request for approving execution of the tool.
x-enumDescriptions.AUTHENTICATION_SUGGESTION: Request for authenticating to a tool, provided as a (tool) suggestion.
x-enumDescriptions.VOTE_SUGGESTION: Suggestion to vote for enabling an available-but-not-enabled tool.
